allowedCommentLines: -- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I05 - Ref-ICAO parsing must use the selected Ref-ICAO APP row.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I06 - PREDEP concatenation must have a route ICAO context.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I06 - answer the current uplink origin if the logon target was cleared.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I07 - PAUSE AT T/D requires an active cruise/T/D context.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I24 - manual N1 retires on an engaged-AP semantic vertical-mode change.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I24 - no FMC N1 reference exists without entered OAT on a non-aspirated aircraft on ground.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I24 - phase and VNAV-arm changes are not manual N1 retirement events.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I24 - the original binary already publishes the normalized PFD vertical mode.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I27 - observed same-arrival landing-flap retraction owns manual FMC go-around inference.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I27 - static flap, thrust and AP state do not prove a go-around.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I33 - a known LevelUp with an invalid contract must never fall back to legacy crew arithmetic.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I33 - do not turn an invalid station contract into a plausible automatic ZFW.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I33 - validate the complete live station contract before publishing automatic FMC ZFW.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I34 - do not command an excessive clean-descent rejoin when speed is not high.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I35 - T/D presence does not revoke go-around ownership.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I35 - a missing T/D is unknown path state, not proof of descent.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I35 - an elapsed T/D does not own phase zero or go-around.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I35 - an upward V/S or LVL CHG target is not descent evidence.
-- FIX: INTENTIONAL FIX I35 - phase zero is not a valid descent owner.
